description: The Wampler Pedals YouTube channel primarily features the long-running "Chasing Tone" podcast and educational content where Brian Wampler and co-hosts discuss practical guitar gear topics like pedalboard setup, signal chain order, and the technical differences between overdrive, boost, and other effects. The videos also delve into pedal design theory and electronics, explaining concepts like impedance, buffers, and circuit topologies to help players understand how their gear actually works. Additionally, the channel offers pedal demos, behind-the-scenes looks at new product development, and Brian's personal insights from running a boutique pedal company.
